fact: At a 7 July 2026 forum ministers and the national employment agency said a Francophonie D-Clic digital training programme has trained 101 young Mauritanians in 2023 and 272 in 2024-2025, with 300 more now in training, run with the Institut supérieur du numérique.
title: انطلاق فعاليات منتدى التشغيل لدعم تشغيل الشباب في المجال الرقمي
